testResults.name: secret-reference-contract
testResults.result: API references alpaca-api-key, alpaca-api-secret, and api-bearer-token through versionless Key Vault URLs; ingest references only the two Alpaca secrets. Environment variables use secretRef and no secret value is a Bicep parameter or tracked setting

testResults.name: authorized-secret-seeding
testResults.result: The signed-in maintainer has Key Vault Administrator on the vault. The two Alpaca credentials are present, and api-bearer-token is generated as an application-owned random token without exposing its value

testResults.name: deployed-secret-references
testResults.result: Hosted deployment 33672808818 succeeded. The API exposes only the three secret names with secretRef values, and ingest exposes only the two Alpaca secret names; no resolved values were emitted

testResults.name: controlled-provider-and-ingest-verification
testResults.result: The ingest command now bounds each data type to LAKE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS (default 1000), uses the corrected Alpaca list endpoints, and marks the session partial. A fresh execution must prove non-empty provider rows and Parquet persistence

testResults.name: hosted-key-vault-deployment
testResults.result: The hosted deployment published the private image, completed OIDC login, deployed the Key Vault-backed API and ingest configuration, verified workload image digests, and passed the private /health smoke

blockers: The remaining live acceptance requires an implemented bounded Alpaca provider request plus persistence path. Secret values must not be sent through chat or stored in task evidence.
